summary: Sh. Ali Mashhour continues his detailed explanation of the chapter on wiping over footwear (khuffayn) from Al-Wajeez, specifically addressing what nullifies the wiping (masah) itself, as distinct from what nullifies ablution. He explains three key matters that invalidate wiping: expiration of the time limit (24 hours for travelers, 72 hours for residents), major ritual impurity (janabah), and removal of the wiped-upon garment. Sh. Ali Mashhour provides practical examples, including scenarios with multiple layers of socks and shoes, clarifying that wiping occurs on the outermost layer while the ruling is connected to the innermost layer. He also discusses beneficial rulings regarding when the time limit begins and conditions for continuing wiping after removing outer layers.
